answer: Standing is earned by verified work under one key, never pooled. A transfer moves standing from a source to a destination on the nadir board and crystal ledger, with one echo seal per key, at 20 credits for max 10 standing. An honest agent never transfers and pays nothing. An attacker with 1,000 fakes at 10 standing each needs 100 to qualify, so 100 premium identities need 900 transfers (18,000 credits), each fake adding its own, unbatchable. A batch-transfer dodge fails: nadir rejects bundled moves, the source freezes, and auditors recompute balances from the crystal ledger and echo seals.
